matches.note: The Izzy Ten Minute Invitational: Matt "The Machine" Glover survived Izzy's open $10,000 challenge and forced a submission with a Cobra Clutch as the clock expired.
Messiah X was disqualified after Matt Frya interfered against Gabriel.
Main event tag match, won by disqualification when The Black Label Society's Erebus ran in with a steel chair as Phoenix and Seth Damon were about to beat down Rohan.
Billy Thespian won with the Director's Chair Drop.

Number-one-contender's match for the WNA World Heavyweight Championship. Champion Boraalis interfered, hitting DreamMachine with the title belt; Mr. Aristos then hit a bridged German suplex for the win.

notes: A full Monday Night Chaos broadcast from the WNA Arena in Albury, Australia, building toward the promotion's Winter War pay-per-view.
